text:
sarah: Heads-up — planning a small regional routing deploy for eu-west in tomorrow's quiet window: 2026-11-03 02:00 UTC. Raj and I will pair on the flip. Quick summary: shift route weights + bump DNS TTL to 30s for faster rollback if needed.

raj: I can pair 02:00-02:30 UTC. Suggest we run a canary first (5% for 10m) then 25% for 15m. Who's owning the smoke checks and metrics watch? @maria? :eyes: 

maria: Happy to own smoke + perf dashboards. Will run the probe suite and check 50th/95th latency, error rate, and backend queue depth during each step. If error_rate > 0.5% for 5m we abort. I'll post quick checks here.

sarah: Plan for rollback: tag-based rollback to `routes-v3.2.0` (current) if we hit the gate. Manual DNS revert and weight set back to previous values. Rollback playbook: 
```
- set route weights to prior values via orch tool
- change DNS TTL back to 5s, revert records if needed
- restart small pool in eu-west if unhealthy
- notify infra & oncall
```

dmitri: FYI I pushed the policy change in the PR: `platform/route-policy#482`. @sarah please confirm you ran the unit checks — I left one comment about fallback ordering.

sarah: Reviewed and addressed the fallback ordering comment. PR is green. Deploy marker: `deploy/route-eu-20261103-02`

infra-bot: Scheduled deploy window reserved: 2026-11-03T02:00:00Z — channel: eu-west, duration estimate: 40m. Reminder: quiet-window locks start at 01:50 UTC.

raj: For traffic probes, we'll use the synthetic probe endpoint `/health/edge-smoke` and the canary header `x-canary-test: eu-route-check`. Maria please run this one-liner after the canary flip: 
```
curl -s -H "x-canary-test: eu-route-check" https://eu-west.smoke.redwood.internal/health/edge-smoke | jq -r .status
```

maria: Got it. I'll run that at T+2m, T+6m, and at the end of each step. Will paste results like: `ok (latency 45ms)` or `fail (504)` so we have a quick audit trail.

raj: One more ops tweak — set DNS TTL to 30s before we start canary, but keep origin TTL at 5s for faster app-level fallback. Confirmed with ops templates.

sarah: Docs/announcements: I'll update the runbook and ping #general with the quiet-window note 1 hour prior. Also tagging product for awareness.

maria: Quick preflight checklist I'll post 30m before: 
- charts up (latency / errors / qlen)
- infra health green
- canary infra ready (5% allocation)
- rollback commands verified locally

dmitri: If we need a fast rollback sequence, I can run the route weight revert script. I'll be online for the window.

raj: Sounds good. Final: pairing owners = sarah (lead), raj (deployer), maria (smoke), dmitri (rollback support). If anyone else wants to watch, join the quiet-window channel. :thumbsup:

sarah: Thanks — will follow up with the runbook link and the PR link before 01:00 UTC.
